title: Regression when using attributes as part of scope
body:
When using `{attributes: {include: [...]}` as part of a scope, the query crashes with ```Unhandled rejection TypeError: include.attributes.map is not a function``` resulting from the expectation that attributes is an array on #1129 of query-generator.js. 

This used to work just fine.

## What you are doing?
Setting the following as a scope. 
```js
          return {
            attributes: {
              include: [
                [sequelize.literal('(select "organisation_participation_id" from "participations" where "session_id" = "'+session_referencer+'.Session"."id" and "role" = \'owner\')'), 'owner']
              ]
            }
          };
```

## What do you expect to happen?
I expect the attributes specified to be included. 

## What is actually happening?
